vehicle-repainter:title: Vehicle Repaint
vehicle-repainter:update_notice_body:
- Choose Factory, Matte, Satin, Gloss, or High Gloss independently of the paint color.
- Preview the selected color and finish before repainting.
- Paint finishes are saved per vehicle and restored when loading a save.
- Repaint prices now depend on the finish, from $800 to $1,800.
